applicability: CORE or Marketplace Portal accounts with the corresponding optional product records, service profile 4.1.0. Existing base product rules apply alongside these additional terms.
content:
CURRENT_ROLLING observations show qualifying external settled net volume at issue time. Capacity review still uses its own current window unless an eligible locked certificate applies. A positive observation can therefore differ from a later review without either record being erroneous.

Detailed local effects and operation names: `RST-volume`.

provenance.source: Primary-author synthetic extension of the frozen 4.0.2 business mechanisms; no claim of a verbatim source SOP rule.
